verdict: Governance infrastructure hardened: 20/20 test PASS, 5 active rules (3 BLOCK, 2 WARN), 25 artifacts audited, S725 Detection Standard v1.0 prohibits all 8 forbidden methodologies, S725 Scan Methodology Standard v1.0 codifies allowed methodologies, 6/6 ownership gaps assigned, 24 phantom references documented with remediation ledger. However, governance guard itself is non-compliant with its own Detection Standard (DL-029-vulnerable Rule 2 forward-scan — P0 fix required), 0/6 gap acceptances confirmed, 0/24 phantom references remediated, and 3/7 tools remain non-compliant. Remediation is scoped and assigned.
